description: VMware vSphere 集群视角总览（vmware-exporter 当前指标命名）：集群 KPI 与超配、主机清单、VM CPU/内存/网络 Top 排行、计算资源与网络趋势、各集群横向对比。

panels.title: 主机数 · Hosts

targets.expr: sum((vmware_host_cpu_corecount{vcenter=~"$vcenter",hostmo=~"$hostmo"} and on(vcenter, hostmo) (vmware_host_power_state{state="poweredOn"} and on(vcenter, hostmo) vmware_host_connection_state{state="connected"} and on(vcenter, hostmo) vmware_host_maintenance_mode == 0)))

panels.title: 逻辑核心 · Cores

targets.expr: sum((vmware_host_mem_capacity_bytes{vcenter=~"$vcenter",hostmo=~"$hostmo"} and on(vcenter, hostmo) (vmware_host_power_state{state="poweredOn"} and on(vcenter, hostmo) vmware_host_connection_state{state="connected"} and on(vcenter, hostmo) vmware_host_maintenance_mode == 0)))

panels.title: 物理内存 · Memory
运行中 VM · Powered VMs

targets.expr: sum((vmware_vm_cpu_corecount{vcenter=~"$vcenter"} and on(vcenter, vmmo) vmware_vm_power_state{state="poweredOn"}) * on(vmmo) group_left max by(vmmo)(vmware_vm_info{vcenter=~"$vcenter",hostmo=~"$hostmo"}))

panels.title: vCPU 总数 · vCPUs

targets.expr: sum((vmware_vm_mem_capacity_bytes{vcenter=~"$vcenter"} and on(vcenter, vmmo) vmware_vm_power_state{state="poweredOn"}) * on(vmmo) group_left max by(vmmo)(vmware_vm_info{vcenter=~"$vcenter",hostmo=~"$hostmo"}))

targets.expr: 100 * sum(vmware_host_cpu_usage_hertz{vcenter=~"$vcenter",hostmo=~"$hostmo"}) / sum((vmware_host_cpu_capacity_hertz{vcenter=~"$vcenter",hostmo=~"$hostmo"} and on(vcenter, hostmo) (vmware_host_power_state{state="poweredOn"} and on(vcenter, hostmo) vmware_host_connection_state{state="connected"} and on(vcenter, hostmo) vmware_host_maintenance_mode == 0)) * (vmware_host_cpu_corecount{vcenter=~"$vcenter",hostmo=~"$hostmo"} and on(vcenter, hostmo) (vmware_host_power_state{state="poweredOn"} and on(vcenter, hostmo) vmware_host_connection_state{state="connected"} and on(vcenter, hostmo) vmware_host_maintenance_mode == 0)))

panels.title: CPU 使用率 · CPU Usage

targets.expr: 100 * sum(vmware_host_mem_consumed_bytes{vcenter=~"$vcenter",hostmo=~"$hostmo"}) / sum((vmware_host_mem_capacity_bytes{vcenter=~"$vcenter",hostmo=~"$hostmo"} and on(vcenter, hostmo) (vmware_host_power_state{state="poweredOn"} and on(vcenter, hostmo) vmware_host_connection_state{state="connected"} and on(vcenter, hostmo) vmware_host_maintenance_mode == 0)))
